Results for tool call 'crawl_page' with arguments '{'url': 'https://rheumatology.org/annual-meeting-abstract-embargo-policies', 'query': 'when can information beyond abstracts be disclosed during ACR Convergence 2024'}':
- All abstracts accepted to ACR Convergence are under media embargo once presenters are notified of acceptance. They may be presented at other meetings or published as manuscripts after notification but not discussed in non-scholarly venues/outlets.
- Accepted abstracts are published publicly online in advance of the meeting and in a special online supplement of *Arthritis & Rheumatology*. Information within the abstract may not be released until the abstracts appear online.
- Exception: Academic institutions, private organizations, and companies with products whose value may be influenced by abstract info may issue a press release coinciding with abstract availability on the ACR website.
- Information beyond the abstract (e.g., discussion of the abstract in editorial news coverage) is under media embargo until **10:00 AM ET on November 7**. (Based on the policy text, this date corresponds to the ACR Convergence meeting for which the embargo lifts; the page's general policy references this November 7 time, aligning with ACR Convergence 2024 disclosure rules.)
- Journalists with embargoed info cannot release articles or editorial news coverage before 10:00 AM ET on November 7. Editorial news coverage = original articles/videos by employed journalists using multiple sources (research, releases, events, etc.).
- Violations may lead to abstract withdrawal and other measures. Authors must notify all stakeholders of the policy.
- Questions: contact abstracts@rheumatology.org.
